g.text: Commercial · drawings generated from the IFC model
IFC file generated by GRAPHISOFT ARCHICAD-64 20.0.0 GER FULL Windows version (IFC2x3 add-on version: 4009 GER FULL). The EXPRESS Data Manager Version 5.02.0100.09 : 26 Sep 2013
Plans are cut from the 3D model 1.2 m above each floor.
Schedules list the model’s own property values.
Tags on plans match the Mark column of the schedules.
Roof and foundation levels have no plan sheet.
